services.desc: Heritage Hall at the John Jay French Museum is open for rentals! The space has flexible seating and table arrangements and is perfect for children’s birthdays, bridal showers, and baby showers! Rentals come with one hour free of setup and tables and chairs are included. Rentals require a two-hour minimum of $75 per hour ($150) and $50 for every subsequent hour.
